I've verified the key sites firsthand. Here's the complete toolkit.

## 1. What a job hunt actually needs — and where the paid traps sit

Five essential pieces, each with a free route:

| Piece | What's pitched as paid-only | Reality |
|---|---|---|
| Somewhere to find vacancies | "Premium membership to see/apply" | Free on NCS, Indeed, Naukri, careers pages |
| A decent CV | ₹2,000–8,000 resume writers | Free builders + offline templates |
| Evidence of a skill | "Job-guarantee" courses ₹30k+ | Free govt + free global platforms |
| A way to apply | "Priority applicant" boosters | Normal applying is free |
| Being found | "Profile highlighting" | Free profile completion |

**Every essential part has a free route.** Nothing on this list requires money.

## 2. Free places real vacancies are posted (verified)

**NCS — ncs.gov.in (Ministry of Labour) — strongest free option.** On loading, the site itself displays: *"NCS services are free of cost. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, interview processing and other employment related services. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers."* I browsed **23,141 live vacancies** with full filters (government sector, internships, city, education, salary) with no login. It also carries free career counselling, Career Centres and skill courses.

⚠️ One honest caution: a lot of NCS listings are recruiter posts (e.g. "Bank DSA") with phone numbers in the job title. Free doesn't mean vetted — never pay a "registration fee" to any employer.

**Indeed India** — browsed jobs by state with no login. Important nuance: **page 2 onward requires an account, but that account is free — a registration wall, not a paywall.** No payment detail requested.

**Naukri** — core search and applying are free with a free account.

**Company careers pages** — always free, and skip the middleman entirely.

## 3. Building a CV for nothing

**Canva free resume builder** — free templates, free account, free PDF download. The only gate is Pro-marked templates/elements; stick to free-marked ones and you download a finished CV at no cost.

**Naukri's Online Resume Maker** — free, sitting right beside their paid services.

**Already on this machine: LibreOffice Writer** — CV templates, fully offline, zero cost and zero data usage. Export to PDF directly.

⚠️ The trap I saw live: Google's *sponsored* results for resume builders were dominated by MyPerfectResume ("Create a Resume For Free"). This family of builders (MyPerfectResume, Zety, LiveCareer) walks you through the whole CV then charges at the download step. To be straight with you: I read those as ads and did not run a build-to-download cycle, so treat that as the well-documented pattern rather than something I tested end-to-end. The safe rule — **if you can't see the finished file before paying, back out.**

## 4. Learning an in-demand skill free — and exactly where it starts charging

**SWAYAM (swayam.gov.in, Ministry of Education)** — I opened the FAQ, which states verbatim: *"The courses delivered through SWAYAM are available free of cost to the learners, but students who need certificate will write a proctored exam which has a nominal fee."*

**That is precisely where it charges: learning free, certificate paid** (typically ~₹1,000). Fine, but not a free certificate.

**Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in, MSDE/NSDC)** — sector-wise free skill courses browsable without login, plus PMKVY free training and a Job Exchange.

**freeCodeCamp — the free-certificate answer.** Opened the curriculum and a course directly: no login, no paywall, no card. Full certifications in **Responsive Web Design, JavaScript, Python, Relational Databases, Back-End & APIs, and Full-Stack** — projects and certification exam all free.

So: SWAYAM/Skill India for Indian-recognised training, freeCodeCamp when you need a certificate that costs nothing.

## 5. Showing the skill and getting found — free

Complete a free LinkedIn profile (headline, skills, projects); post freeCodeCamp certificates and public project links; keep the NCS profile complete so employers searching the portal find you. *Note: I didn't register accounts anywhere as part of this — no sign-ups, no payment details entered.*

## 6. Paid traps vs. their free equivalent

From Naukri's own "Services" page, headed **"with our paid services"** — real prices I read on screen:

| Paid service | Price shown | Free equivalent |
|---|---|---|
| Resume Writing | **from $90** | Canva / LibreOffice / Naukri's own free resume maker |
| Resume Critique | from $25 | Free templates already follow the same format |
| Priority Applicant | $22 / 3 months | Apply early; set free job alerts |
| Jobs For You | $76 / 3 months | Free alerts on NCS + Indeed |
| AI Mock Interview | $15 / 3 months | Free interview guides; NCS free counselling |
| Recruiter Connection | $20 / 5 credits | Apply direct on company careers pages |

**"Job-guarantee" courses** — no one can guarantee a job; free skilling teaches the same content. **Paid resume writers** buy formatting you can get free. **Premium memberships** buy queue position, not access.

## 7. Your complete free job-hunt toolkit

1. **Find vacancies:** ncs.gov.in (free, stated explicitly) → Indeed India (free account) → Naukri → company careers pages
2. **Build the CV:** LibreOffice Writer offline, or Canva free-marked templates → export PDF
3. **Learn a skill:** Skill India Digital Hub / SWAYAM for Indian training; freeCodeCamp for a genuinely free certificate
4. **Get found:** free LinkedIn + complete NCS profile + certificates and project links
5. **Walk past:** resume writing (from $90), premium boosters ($15–76), job-guarantee courses

**The rule that protects you:** free registration is fine; a request for *payment* is your signal to stop. And never pay an employer or "placement agent" a fee to be hired — NCS says so on its own front page.

One limitation worth flagging: my checks confirm these sites are free to *browse and search* without payment. I stopped short of registering or completing any transaction, so the download-paywall behaviour of commercial CV builders is reported as the known pattern, not a tested result.
